theme_central: Man, created in hardship (kabad), refuses to commit to the steep path — freeing, feeding, believing, and enjoining patience and compassion.
sources_note: Content widely taught and undisputed: the "steep path" (al-'aqaba) and the People of the Right/Left are classical landmarks.

branches.title: Oath, man in hardship
branches.resume: Oath by this City (Mecca) and by the Prophet who is free there; man created in hardship.

children.t: Oath by the sacred City, man created in hardship

branches.title: The illusion of impunity
branches.resume: Man boasts of having squandered wealth, thinking no one saw him.

children.t: Illusion of impunity, boasting about squandered wealth

branches.title: The two paths shown
branches.resume: Two eyes, a tongue, two lips; the two paths of good and evil shown to man.

children.t: Organs given to man, the two paths of good and evil shown

branches.title: The steep path
branches.resume: Freeing a slave, feeding on a day of famine an orphaned relative or a poor person in destitution.

children.t: The steep path: freeing, feeding the orphan and the poor

branches.title: People of the Right, people of the Left
branches.resume: Believing and enjoining patience and compassion; contrasting fate according to the side chosen.

children.t: Faith, patience and compassion; People of the Right vs People of the Left
